text_post: The last two days the topic of suicide has come up in my conversations. At one of the places I work at two men in the area committed suicide and while I don’t know the circumstances I can only speculate things were not right on the home front. My best friend told me another man committed suicide at a restaurant over a woman. We could only shake our heads and wish he had gone his own way. Spent 10 years dealing with suicidal thoughts every day and came up with every imaginable way to off myself even considering finding a jiadist to do us both a service. It’s not for me to judge, would be a hypocrite if I did because if circumstances were different may have done it if my doctor had given me a different answer, will never know. If you do have these thoughts, please get help, talk to us on here or get professional guidance, you are not alone, your life may be difficult beyond your control, but there are over 22,000 men on here like you who understand.

text_post: Well said! There is no shame either, or weakness. I actually think in these f~~~ed up times, where everything has been turned upside down, to not feel depressed at times would be a sign of an unhealthy, or extremely distracted or in denial mind. Although I feel a but like a hypocrite because I had thoughts in my darkest times of “Your gun is right there… it can all be over in a second…” but I have never seriously considered it because of my dogs… But yes, like Wally says get help if it is something you are seriously considering as an option. You have value to us. If you are lonely, get a dog, and treat it the way you never were treated. With complete kindness and acceptance. It will reward you and your life 100 fold in return.

I am struggling. I feel like a failure every day, but by the grace of God, I am alive the next morning to wake up and try again. I am in a struggle against things I can not see but feel them when I am struck down. I may be knocked down, but I get up every time. I will get up and face my task, obstacle, duty, job head on. I will do the best I can every time. I am a man. I am capable of absorbing this and so much more. I am a survivor of stuff that would turn your s~~~ green. I will continue to survive. I have no choice. I will continue to push back until my lungs no longer draw breath, my heart no longer beats and my mind is finally still. I believe in myself in a way no one else will.

text_post: I’ve studied WW2 extensively, especially while writing my fiction novel. The adversity these people endured is monumental compared to my experiences in life. That in no way minimizes what I went through, but it has taught me to persevere when I was at my lowest points. I have plenty to live for, and every day is a new opportunity to make a difference in the world both here and in the not so virtual world. We each have the ability to inspire others and create what we want out of life. Think on the blessings in your life and don’t dwell on the darkness. There is always light to behold. Stay positive and focus on goodness and strength. Life is supposed to be hard, otherwise you wouldn’t appreciate the joys it can bring.
